description.en: find hidden tail risks and design antifragile systems
description.zh: 发现隐藏的尾部风险，设计反脆弱系统

goal.en: Spot fragility and build antifragile systems
goal.zh: 识别脆弱性，构建反脆弱系统

outcome.en: Apply Taleb's risk philosophy: identify hidden exposures, eliminate fragility, and structure systems that gain from disorder.
outcome.zh: 运用塔勒布的风险哲学：识别隐性风险敞口，消除脆弱性，构建从无序中获益的系统。

reason.en: Distilled Taleb: fat-tail thinking, "skin in the game" test, and antifragility design heuristics.
reason.zh: 蒸馏自塔勒布：肥尾思维、"切肤之痛"检验，以及反脆弱设计启发法。

en: Identify hidden tail risks in this plan
Apply the skin-in-the-game test to this decision
zh: 找出这个方案中的隐性尾部风险
对这个决策做切肤之痛检验
让这个系统更具反脆弱性
